scope: Fixed native 512px crop coordinates chosen from visible ceiling structure, before local contrast calculation; apparent similar finish, not measured reflectance or equal illumination.
coordinates: x0,y0,x1,y1 half-open rectangles; no new geometry fit

ceiling_lamp.policy: Target is ceiling above housing/core; no orange-pixel selection. Primary background is on same visible panel row. Other similar-finish panels test sensitivity, not known unlit controls.

middle_ceiling.policy: Only ceiling above fixture is compared. Small/narrow same-panel control, sparse absolute orange area; do not infer complete orange annulus. Lower control rejected because the next lamp is visible below the crop.
